initial_root_checksum_table: Stale 435-page artifact hashes found during coordinator acceptance; replaced by final external SHA256SUMS after the new PDF/ZIP bytes were frozen.
packaging_rule: Root SHA256SUMS and DELIVERY.json are excluded from the sourceZIP; these external manifests alone record final PDF/ZIP SHA256 and byte sizes. The internal upstream-BUILDABLE_CLOSURE_SHA256.tsv is pinned English-source provenance, not a delivery checksum table.
no_checksum_cycle: The archive never contains its own final checksum, nor a manifest that purports to store its final checksum. Clean-rebuild reports may identify the earlier staged archive actually extracted, explicitly labelled as staged.
final_verification: Final external DELIVERY.json and SHA256SUMS are generated only after the last metadata-only ZIP repack; scripts/finalize_delivery.py verifies631actually rebuilt TeX hashes and excludes every root/nested SHA256SUMS.
